title: File:Rama VI, Rama V, and Prince Asdang Dejavudh (1904).png
author: Prajadhipok
credit: ระยะทางเที่ยวชวากว่าสองเดือน
description:
Portrait of King Chulalongkorn (Rama V), His Majesty the King (Rama VI, the reigning monarch at the time of publication), and Prince Asdang Dejavudh (Krom Luang Nakhon Ratchasima), taken in the Year of the Dragon, B.E. 2447 (1904).
(This photograph was taken by Prince Prajadhipok, Krom Khun Sukhothai Thammaracha [future King Rama VII], himself when he was young.)
